tagline: A clear-water island off Pattaya — white-sand beaches, snorkeling, water sports, and an easy day trip by sea from Chonburi
introHtml:
Koh Larn is a small island just off Pattaya in Chonburi province, reachable by boat in under an hour. It's a clear-water getaway that people from Bangkok and visitors come to for a day trip or an overnight, because the sand is whiter and the water far clearer than the beaches on the Pattaya side.

The island has several beaches to choose from. Tawaen is the main, busiest beach, with the full range of water sports — parasailing, banana boats, and snorkeling. Samae and Nuan are quieter with clear water and are good for lazing around, while Tien is a calmer beach on the other side. If you want to stay over, there are places to sleep and seafood restaurants on the island. Koh Larn works for swimmers, water-sports fans, and anyone who just wants to relax by the beach. Honesty: it gets very crowded on holidays and the boats are packed, so go early; check the price and safety of water sports before you ride; the sea is murky on some days depending on the weather; and help keep the beaches clean by taking your trash back with you.
bestTime: November–April brings good weather and clear water, ideal for swimming, snorkeling, and water sports — this is the popular season. The rainy season, May–October, has spells of rain and murky water on some days, but you can still get there by boat.

highlights.name: Tawaen Beach
highlights.blurb: The main and busiest beach on Koh Larn, with white sand, clear water, the full range of water sports, restaurants, and deck chairs for rent. This is where the big boats from Pattaya dock.

highlights.name: Samae Beach
highlights.blurb: A white-sand beach with clear water and a quieter, more natural feel than Tawaen. Good for relaxing and snorkeling over the coral just off the beach.

highlights.name: Nuan Beach (Monkey Beach)
highlights.blurb: A small, peaceful beach with very clear water, good for escaping the crowds. The mood is private, with a few small restaurants along the sand.

highlights.name: Tien Beach
highlights.blurb: A beach on the other side of the island, calm with clear water, water sports, and beachside restaurants. Good if you want to avoid the crowds at Tawaen.

highlights.name: Water Sports
highlights.blurb: Koh Larn has the full set — parasailing, banana boats, jet skis, and snorkeling — especially at Tawaen Beach. It's one of the island's most popular activities.

highlights.name: Koh Larn Viewpoint
highlights.blurb: A viewpoint on a hill in the middle of the island, looking out over the beaches and clear water all around, with a Koh Larn sign. A popular photo spot.

foodScene.name: Beachside Seafood
foodScene.note: Tawaen Beach and the pier at Na Ban have restaurants with fresh seafood — prawns, shellfish, crab, and fish, grilled, steamed, or stir-fried, eaten by the sea in the breeze. Prices depend on the place and the season.

foodScene.name: Beach Restaurants and Deck Chairs
foodScene.note: Along the beaches there are made-to-order food and drink spots with deck chairs for rent, so you can eat and swim all day. An easy, relaxed beach vibe.

foodScene.name: Cafes and Snacks
foodScene.note: The Na Ban pier area and Tawaen Beach have cafes, dessert shops, and snacks to drop by — while you wait for the boat or take a break from swimming.

foodScene.name: Local Island Food
foodScene.note: In Na Ban village there are made-to-order shops and rice-and-curry spots at local prices, a cheaper option than the beachside restaurants for those staying overnight.

attractions.name: Coral Snorkeling
attractions.blurb: Off Samae Beach and at spots around the island there's coral to snorkel over, with clear water on a good day. A favorite activity for visitors to Koh Larn.

attractions.name: Tawaen Beach Water Sports
attractions.blurb: Parasailing, banana boats, jet skis, and sea walking at Tawaen Beach. Check the price and safety before you ride.

attractions.name: Na Ban Village
attractions.blurb: The pier area and Na Ban village, with restaurants, places to stay, motorbike rentals, and island life. The main spot for boarding and getting off the boats.
